description: Vertical 1080x1920 dark background. Frame 0: large glowing accent=cyan DNA double helix in vertical center (35-65% height), rotating slowly, base-pair rungs in fg=white and accent2=magenta. Below it in lower-middle a small metallic grey hard drive for scale. Big bold fg=white text '200 PETABYTES' pops in center. Camera pushes in slightly then helix shrinks rapidly downward into a tiny glowing cyan droplet that hovers above the hard drive. No key elements in top 10% or bottom 25%.

beats.action: Glowing cyan double helix fills center rotating, bold white '1 GRAM' text slams in above it
Helix brightens and spins faster, magenta rungs pulse
Helix begins rapid shrink toward center-bottom, motion blur trail
Helix collapses into tiny cyan droplet hovering above grey hard drive that slides in to middle
Huge white '200 PETABYTES' text scales up behind droplet and drive, droplet glows

description: Vertical 1080x1920 dark background with vertical split in middle band (30-70% height). Left panel dark with streaming fg=white binary digits 0 and 1 falling. Right panel dark with four huge floating letters A in good=green, T in accent3=yellow, C in accent=cyan, G in accent2=magenta. Thin muted=grey divider line center. Pulsing fg=white question mark and small file-to-flask icon appear center-bottom of middle band. Kinetic typography, no 3D.

beats.action: Left panel fills middle with cascading white 0s and 1s, right panel empty dark
Left 0s and 1s enlarge and march left-to-right, zeros glow cyan
Grey divider wipes in center, right panel slides in empty with DNA label
Four giant letters A T C G pop in on right in green yellow cyan magenta with bounce
G letter flashes magenta then all four letters glow together
White question mark pulses center between panels, file icon morphs toward flask icon below it

description: Vertical 1080x1920 dark background, middle band focus. Top-middle: four mapping cards in a row A=00 in good=green, C=01 in accent=cyan, G=10 in accent2=magenta, T=11 in accent3=yellow, fg=white text. Center: six white bit tiles 0 1 1 0 1 1 in a row. Bottom-middle: horizontal strand slot, grey printer head block above it and cyan scanner light bar. All 2D flat motion graphics.

beats.action: Four dim mapping cards A C G T fade in top-middle row
A card lights green and lifts showing 00 in white
C card lights cyan and lifts showing 01
G card lights magenta showing 10 and T card lights yellow showing 11
Six white bit tiles 0 1 1 0 1 1 slide in center row below cards
Grey brackets snap down grouping tiles into three pairs 01 | 10 | 11 with gap
First pair 01 slides up and pops into cyan C block
Second pair 10 slides up and pops into magenta G block next to C
Third pair 11 slides up and pops into yellow T block forming CGT strand in slot
Grey printer head sweeps left-to-right building CGT beads bead-by-bead, then cyan scanner light sweeps back turning beads into white bits below

description: Vertical 1080x1920 dark background. Center-middle single glowing accent=cyan DNA helix vertical. It duplicates into hundreds of small glowing cyan and magenta helices swirling and funneling into a small glass vial centered in middle band. Vial glows good=green. Frozen ice-blue overlay with large fg=white year counter '0 YEARS -> 10,000 YEARS' beside vial and bold white text 'ULTIMATE BACKUP'. No key elements in top 10% or bottom 25%.

beats.action: Single bright cyan helix rotates large in center
Helix duplicates into dozens then hundreds of glowing helices filling center cloud
Camera pulls back, cloud funnels down into small glass vial center, year counter starts ticking fast
Grey power plug icon appears and fades with red X, vial glows green and freezes with ice shine
Bold white 'ULTIMATE BACKUP DRIVE' text scales up behind vial, vial pulses
